parameters.query:
SELECT codigo,
       to_char(fecha_creacion AT TIME ZONE 'America/Guatemala', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS fecha,
       departamento,
       asunto,
       COALESCE(categoria, 'Sin clasificar') AS categoria,
       COALESCE(prioridad, 'Sin asignar') AS prioridad,
       estado
FROM v_tickets_detalle
WHERE fecha_creacion >= $1::timestamptz
  AND fecha_creacion <  $2::timestamptz
ORDER BY CASE prioridad WHEN 'ALTA' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIA' THEN 2 WHEN 'BAJA' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, codigo;

INSERT INTO reportes (periodo_inicio, periodo_fin, total_tickets, archivo, resumen)
SELECT $1::timestamptz, $2::timestamptz,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE fecha_creacion >= $1::timestamptz AND fecha_creacion < $2::timestamptz),
  $3,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'por_categoria', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(c, n), '{}'::jsonb)
                      FROM (SELECT COALESCE(categoria, 'Sin clasificar') AS c, COUNT(*) AS n
                            FROM v_tickets_detalle WHERE fecha_creacion >= $1::timestamptz AND fecha_creacion < $2::timestamptz GROUP BY 1) s),
    'por_prioridad', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(p, n), '{}'::jsonb)
                      FROM (SELECT COALESCE(prioridad, 'Sin asignar') AS p, COUNT(*) AS n
                            FROM v_tickets_detalle WHERE fecha_creacion >= $1::timestamptz AND fecha_creacion < $2::timestamptz GROUP BY 1) s),
    'por_estado',    (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(e, n), '{}'::jsonb)
                      FROM (SELECT estado AS e, COUNT(*) AS n
                            FROM v_tickets_detalle WHERE fecha_creacion >= $1::timestamptz AND fecha_creacion < $2::timestamptz GROUP BY 1) s)
  )
RETURNING id, total_tickets, archivo, resumen;

INSERT INTO auditoria (workflow, accion, resultado, ticket_id, origen_ip, detalle)
VALUES ('WF3_reportes', 'generar_reporte', 'OK', NULL, 'interno', $1::jsonb);
